mutually exclusive first-class options: text deltas may arrive with no usage, usage may arrive alone
always Some - partial chunks are forbidden

usage is serialized as the message id
explanation: There is no rejection - usage-before-text is legal input to the aggregator.
The final usage overwrites previous ones; ordering problems are silent.
complete()'s entire body is stream + collect_stream.

explanation: It serializes to JSON and SHA-256s the bytes; no compression.
